cyclone_michaung_2023.title: Cyclone Michaung (Dec 2023)
cyclone_michaung_2023.description: Severe cyclonic storm producing catastrophic coastal and eyewall deluge (>200mm) over Andhra Pradesh and Chennai.

wayanad_cloudburst_2024.title: Wayanad Orographic Cloudburst (July 2024)
wayanad_cloudburst_2024.description: Extreme orographic windward rainfall (>260mm) along Western Ghats escarpment triggering devastating debris flows.

north_india_wd_2023.title: North India WD Extreme (July 2023)
north_india_wd_2023.description: Upper-tropospheric westerly trough interacting with monsoon flow causing catastrophic Beas & Yamuna floods.

monsoon_break_spell_2023.title: Monsoon Break Spell (Aug 2023)
monsoon_break_spell_2023.description: Monsoon trough shifted north to foothills; dry central India vs intense sub-Himalayan / Meghalaya downpours.

bay_of_bengal_depression_2023.title: Bay of Bengal Deep Depression (Sept 2023)
bay_of_bengal_depression_2023.description: Monsoon depression tracking west-northwest across Odisha and Central India with heavy spiral rainbands.

active_monsoon_peak_2022.title: Active Monsoon Peak Surge (July 2022)
active_monsoon_peak_2022.description: Intense southwesterly low-level jet driving widespread heavy precipitation across peninsular & central India.
